quote.text: Stop preventing philosophers from possessing money; no one has condemned wisdom to poverty. I will despise whatever lies in the domain of Fortune, but if a choice is offered, I will choose the better half.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Embrace the idea that nurturing wisdom in your children matters more than accumulating wealth; truth and understanding will guide them far better than material assets ever could.
    • In the realm of parenting, focus on instilling values and intellectual curiosity—teaching your children that while resources can be useful, the true treasure is a well-cultivated mind and character.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, recognize that financial resources are tools, but the true strength of leadership lies in steadfast wisdom, integrity, and ethical resolve; choose what benefits the common good over fleeting riches.
    • In every decision, balance the practical demands of resources with the larger duty of guiding others towards meaningful and virtuous objectives, ensuring that wisdom remains at the helm.
  • Product Management:
    • In product management, prioritize the creation of value that transcends mere profit. Like wisdom, the best products enrich lives and solve problems in profound ways.
    • Strive for an equilibrium where financial success supports innovation and thoughtful progress—ensuring that your products serve a higher purpose by enhancing the quality of everyday life.
